news.title: Ravi Teja Starrer Irumudi Captures Top Spot on Netflix Global Charts
news.summary: Actor Ravi Teja's Telugu hit movie Irumudi has surged to the number one position globally on Netflix's Non-English Movies category. news.title: Dragon is firmly on schedule for its 2027 premiere
news.summary: Producer Ravi Shankar of Mythri Movie Makers has dismissed postponement rumors, confirming that the NTR and Prashanth Neel action film Dragon will hit theatres on June 11, 2027. The narrative features NTR as an assassin alongside a supporting cast including Anil Kapoor, Rukmini Vasanth, and Biju Menon.

news.title: Urvashi Rautela Enters Massive Legal Battle With AI Firm Over Identity Misuse
news.summary: Bollywood actress Urvashi Rautela has reportedly initiated a major legal pursuit demanding ₹7,000 crores in damages from a Los Angeles-based artificial intelligence company. news.title: Tollywood Faces Major Financial Shifts as OTT Platforms Tighten Budgets
news.summary: Digital streaming platforms have drastically reduced their acquisition budgets, posing a serious challenge for Tollywood producers relying on post-theatrical sales. With streaming companies offering far lower prices than expected, big-budget ventures and medium-range movies alike are facing a financial squeeze. Consequently, filmmakers may soon have to depend heavily on theatrical revenues to achieve financial recovery.
